status: frozen before inference; all CPU controls passed; exact cold restore verified and drive unmounted
experiment_class: One fresh task-scoped usefulness diagnostic. Changed source projection, model prompt and output/step budgets prevent a controlled comparison with earlier full-snapshot failures. Not model, package, runtime or unattended-worker qualification.

task.cpu_control_authority: Storage-admission agent supplies exact scoped baseline-failure/actual-fixed-pass receipts using the new planner after a clean commit. These are launch prerequisites, not another permission request.

model.availability_scope: Exact cold model and image were verified in previous local receipts; no fresh drive/image/device inspection performed while authoring this plan. Existing launch checks verify identities again.

runtime.container_policy: read-only root, cap-drop ALL plus SYS_PTRACE only, no-new-privileges, UID 0:0, private IPC, loopback API, no restart. Prior CPU pidfd admission retained; no communication fallback.
runtime.lifetime_scope: Graceful stop trigger, not guaranteed cleanup completion; locks remain held until owned workload and render holders exit.

worker.output_budget_reason: 512 tokens / prior observed 9.6065 stream-arrival tokens/s is about 53 seconds, leaving room within the unchanged 120-second generation cap for prefill and transport; this is sizing evidence, not a latency guarantee.
worker.tool_commands: CPU-only sandbox, existing 120-second command bound; follow one-command grammar and scoped selected/new-file notice. No retries of the whole task; acceptance feedback is limited to two checks within the same 12 model steps.

restore.failed_restore: Preserve partial scratch and failure receipt; halt I/O, no remount/retry loop or force/repair. No model launch.

admission_and_sequence: Finalize and commit only the reviewed task/runner/runtime inputs on main; normal clean-repository enforcement remains. Preserve fixed-control/gold files outside model-visible inputs.
Pass scoped baseline marker and corresponding actual fixed-commit CPU control; plan_snapshot must admit this exact 12-file scope on the output filesystem with the 50 GiB floor.
Perform one unchanged cold restore using the new external script path. Verify all 80 source/destination files and clean external unmount; preserve historical restore outputs.

Start the adapted supervisor once under the named systemd unit. It rehashes model files before GPU health probes, acquires all existing lane/card locks, checks no render holders/container/listener conflict, offline blocks 53-57, >=64 GiB available after staging and root >=50 GiB+256 MiB. No two-host calls.

On the same healthy server, execute the frozen eight boundary-marker/repeat diagnostics and one no-execution canary with current worker SYSTEM, exact profile and scoped notice form. Fail/STOP on any wire/token/cache/format/marker discrepancy; no retry.

Before task admission require no STOP/FAULT/shutdown, live owned supervisor/container, >=960 seconds remaining using conservative supervisor PID age, >=24 GiB host MemAvailable, and recheck exact source/task/profile/acceptance/runner bindings.

Run exactly one worker attempt with the pinned task and single-check acceptance directory. Coordinator checks STOP/FAULT/ownership before each new generation and halts further requests on any fault. At 900 seconds send one SIGINT to the owned CPU worker, retain partial evidence and do not escalate.

In coordinator finally request server STOP on success/failure/interruption. Wait for owned CPU sandbox stop and one supervisor-owned graceful model SIGINT; no server restart or automatic device recovery.

Review acceptance and patch independently after sandbox stop; preserve original model outputs, patch/source hashes, raw SSE and timing. Fsync/export verified compact evidence before deleting only owned source snapshots.

After clean model exit and healthy all-four-card postflight, verify retained cold-preservation receipts and rehash all 80 temporary model files before releasing only that RAM copy. Preserve cold model and parked LTX/Flash-Next.
fault_and_scope_limits: No power, host memory, swap, page-cache, GPU clock, firmware or driver settings changed. Existing 10 GiB RAM exclusion stays offline.
Known old one-token prefill bug is avoided by >300-token worker prompts and finite 511/512/513/1025 repeat gates, not claimed fixed. No R314 speculative qualification borrowed.

The DO-NOT-REPEAT policy is respected by a previously unattempted task under a separately frozen scoped protocol, unchanged known runtime, and no revisiting the two failed coding questions or recall sets.
No model requests, mounts, Docker/systemd actions, GPU calls or commits were made to prepare these files.
This plan is not a runnable controller: root owns the gate/canary/client orchestration and final implementation hashes before the authorized attempt.
